additional_info.body:
Hello Cenoiu,
I checked the logs and found that the session actually went correctly:
I searched in a 3 hour period (29/Oct 23:00 until 30/Oct 01:00 UTC) and this is all I could find.
The charging session worked perfectly during this period.
Is this the first time it occured? Unfortunately, I need to enable a specific set of logs in order to find why this happened. To have this specific set of logs active, we cannot do a reboot otherwise we will lose this option.
Let me know what is best for you, since it worked, it might be a one-time occurence. If you want to proceed with checking why this happened, I already enabled the logs collector, so please do not perform a reboot.
Since we don't know when this problem might occur again, I recommend closing it and open when it happens.
Let me know your feedback.
Thanks a lot!
Best regards,
Francisco
